name: squeeze_release_breakout_001
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when Bollinger Bands (2-minute window) compress inside Keltner Channels, institutional algorithms have temporarily suspended directional activity and resting limit orders are stacked symmetrically around a tight range. This equilibrium accumulates directional pressure. When price breaks above the 24-bar rolling high with 90-second and 3-minute EMAs both aligned bullishly and above-average volume participation, algorithmic TWAP/VWAP flow initiates a new directional wave, typically carrying NIFTY 15-25 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds before the next equilibrium forms. The volume surge confirms that institutional orders are actively absorbing supply (or demand) rather than a random spike through the compression range.

indicators.name: bb_upper_24
indicators.purpose: 24-bar (2-min) Bollinger Band upper envelope. NOT 12x blind (which would give 240 bars = same 20-min window as original). Compressed to 2 min because we hold 15-90s: we need to detect micro-compressions at the same timescale as our hold, not session-level consolidations.

indicators.name: bb_lower_24
indicators.purpose: Lower Bollinger Band envelope, same 2-min window.

indicators.name: kc_upper_24
indicators.purpose: Keltner Channel upper. ATR(24) captures 2-min volatility regime. BB inside KC = squeeze state.

indicators.name: kc_lower_24
indicators.purpose: Keltner Channel lower. BB inside KC defines the compression equilibrium.

indicators.name: squeeze_on
indicators.purpose: Compression state flag. True when BB entirely inside KC. We require this to have been True in at least 3 of the 6 bars immediately preceding entry — allowing the release to begin without requiring the squeeze to still be active at the exact entry bar.

indicators.name: squeeze_high_24
indicators.formula: MAX(high, 24) over [i-24, i) — excludes current bar
indicators.purpose: 2-min breakout ceiling. Break of this level by the current close confirms the release is directional, not a wick. Excludes current bar to prevent current-bar high from trivially equaling squeeze_high.

indicators.name: squeeze_low_24
indicators.formula: MIN(low, 24) over [i-24, i) — excludes current bar

indicators.name: ema_short_18
indicators.purpose: 90-second fast EMA. Matches maximum hold time (18 bars × 5s = 90s), ensuring the short-term directional signal aligns with the trade duration. Original EMA(9) was 9 min — far too slow for a 15-90s hold.

indicators.name: ema_long_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute slow EMA. 2× the short EMA period, sufficient context to define the micro-trend direction. Original EMA(21) was 21 min; at 5s resolution the 3-min slow EMA captures the same 'recently established direction' concept at the trade's timescale.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: VWAP() cumulative from 09:15, resets each session
indicators.purpose: Intraday fair value anchor. No scaling — VWAP is a cumulative measure that resets each session. Squeeze breakouts above VWAP are more likely to be institutional buy flow; below VWAP more likely to be institutional sell flow.

indicators.name: rel_volume_24
indicators.purpose: Volume participation filter relative to the 2-min compression window baseline. A breakout with rel_volume >= 1.3 confirms institutional order flow is entering, not a thin-market wick through the range.

conditions: squeeze_on was True in >= 3 of last 6 bars (recent compression present)
buy_ce.confirmation: all conditions met simultaneously on 5s close

conditions: squeeze_on was True in >= 3 of last 6 bars (recent compression present)
buy_pe.confirmation: all conditions met simultaneously on 5s close

exit.stop_rationale: NIFTY squeeze breakouts retrace 8-12 spot points on false breaks. At delta 0.5, that's 4-6 option points. Stopping at 4 points means we exit if NIFTY retraces 8 spot points — the full compression range width — which signals the release thesis has failed. Calibrated to 30-second typical NIFTY moves (2-5 option pts per CONVENTIONS reference table).
exit.target_rationale: First-leg NIFTY squeeze releases carry 15-25 spot points within 60-90 seconds (7-12 option pts at delta 0.5). Targeting 7 points captures the 50th percentile expected move, giving 1:1.75 R:R. Consistent with 1-minute typical NIFTY moves of 3-7 option pts from the CONVENTIONS calibration table.

filters.vix_filter: none — squeeze pattern is self-filtering; low-vol regimes produce fewer valid squeezes
filters.time_filter: 10:00-15:20 IST only — avoids 09:15-10:00 opening noise where BB/KC are unstable with few bars
filters.trend_filter: ema_short_18 > ema_long_36 aligns trade with micro-trend; vwap alignment provides session context
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — squeeze patterns are well-known; crowded setups may fail; NIFTY regime shifts (trending vs choppy) affect frequency

adaptation_notes: Original is a stock universe strategy (nifty500 top 200) at 1-min bars, hold 8-30 min. Converted to single-index NIFTY at 5s bars, hold 15-90s. Three key changes: (1) Squeeze window compressed from 20 bars (20 min) to 24 bars (2 min) — same time concept but calibrated for 5s resolution and 90s hold; (2) EMA periods compressed from 9/21 min to 90s/3 min to match the trade duration; (3) Relative volume uses 24-bar window (matching squeeze period) instead of 20-bar. VWAP and squeeze structure are identical — both are valid at any frequency. The squeeze pattern works on NIFTY because the index absorbs institutional resting orders in the same way individual stocks do, but with higher liquidity and smoother execution.
weaknesses: Squeeze patterns on NIFTY 5s bars are frequent but many are micro-noise; false release signals in choppy sessions will generate losing trades
Volume on NIFTY index is a proxy (futures volume drives the index) — rel_volume filter may be noisy
EMA crossover at 90s/3 min is susceptible to whipsaws in fast-moving sessions
